title: Import Patients Tab
description: Import Patients Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers import patients tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Bulk-import patients from a spreadsheet
subtasks.purpose: Upload a CSV / Excel file to enrol many patients into the practice in one operation.

steps.title: Download & Populate Template
steps.description: Download the sample template if provided, and populate it with patient demographics, program (CCM / RPM) and vitals-target opt-ins.

steps.title: Choose Spreadsheet File
steps.description: Click Choose File and select the completed spreadsheet.

steps.title: Review Import Results
steps.description: Review the result summary — rows created, rows skipped, rows failed — and download the error report for any failures.

steps.title: Fix and Re-Upload Rows
steps.description: Fix the flagged rows in the source file and re-upload just those rows if needed. Notes Patient email must be unique across the practice — duplicates are rejected with a clear error. Import respects the Schedule & Targets configuration active at the time of import.
